tickets.title: Leads get lost between the website and the sales team
tickets.scope: From 'Demo request via website form' to 'Call prospect and give demo'

script.text: Hi! You're the new process consultant, right? I really need your help with something.

We are losing customers before we even talk to them. My assistant spends hours copying website forms into Excel, two reps sometimes call the same company and other leads are never called at all. Marketing launches a big campaign next quarter and expects 3x more demo requests. I will NOT hire a second person to type data. I want leads to arrive at the right rep automatically.

script.intro: Here's what my team measured:
items: 40 demo requests per week, ~15 min of manual work per lead
About 10% of leads are never contacted
Average time between form and first call: 3 working days
Duplicates and typos in the Excel lead list

script.intro: What I want at the end:
items: Every lead stored in one central system within 5 minutes, without retyping
Automatic duplicate check and automatic assignment to a sales rep
First call within 24 hours

tickets.title: New customers wait a week before they can log in
tickets.scope: From the 'New customer' email from Sales to 'Email CS: accounts are ready'

script.text: Hello, do you have a minute? We have a serious problem with new customers.

Customers pay from day one, but they wait about six working days before anybody can log in. Our biggest new client had 300 users and it took our support engineer almost three days to create the accounts by hand. On top of that, the security audit flagged that we email passwords in plain text. This has to stop before the next audit.

script.intro: Here's what my team measured:
items: 6 working days from contract to first login
~45 min per 10 users created by hand
1 user list in 3 contains errors and comes back for correction
Security audit finding: passwords sent by email

script.intro: What I want at the end:
items: Workspace and user accounts ready within 1 working day after signature
No passwords sent by email (users set their own)
Support engineers only involved for special cases

tickets.title: Releases are slow, risky and only on Friday night

script.text: Hey. Quick question – are you the one working on our processes? I have a job for you.

Every release is a small drama. Builds are made on someone's laptop, QA clicks through a 300-step Excel checklist for two days, and Ops copies files to the servers by FTP on Friday night. One release in five has to be rolled back by hand. Our competitors release several times a week. I want releases to be boring.

script.intro: Here's what my team measured:
items: 2 days of manual regression testing per release
Releases only on Friday 22:00 with ~3 h downtime
1 release in 5 rolled back manually
'Works on my machine': builds differ between laptops

script.intro: What I want at the end:
items: Release on any weekday, during office hours, without downtime
Automated tests in less than 1 hour
Rollback in minutes, release notes generated automatically

tickets.title: Customers wait 2 days for an answer – some never get one
tickets.scope: Whole process: from 'Customer emails support@orbitask' to 'Case closed'

script.text: Hi. I'll be direct: our customer support is hurting our reputation and I need a better process.

Yesterday a customer posted on LinkedIn that we 'never answer support emails'. I checked: he was right. Our support team works hard, but everything goes through one shared mailbox and the team lead sorts emails by hand all morning. Nobody knows which cases are open, and customers call us all day to ask for a status update. Fix this.

script.intro: Here's what my team measured:
items: Average first reply: 2 working days
~12% of emails never get an answer
Team lead spends ~1.5 h per day sorting emails
~30 phone calls per day just to ask for status
Same questions answered again and again

script.intro: What I want at the end:
items: Every request becomes a ticket with an owner and a status
First reply within 4 working hours
Customers can see the status themselves and find answers to common questions

tickets.title: Invoicing takes a week and is full of errors
tickets.scope: From '1st working day of the month' to 'Invoice paid'

script.text: Good morning! Finance needs your help, urgently.

Two of my people spend four days every month typing 900 invoices in Word from a CSV that a developer exports for us. Then one of them spends a full day ticking off payments on the bank statement. Customers complain about wrong amounts and reminders that arrive when they have already paid. I want billing to run by itself and my team to do analysis, not typing.

script.intro: Here's what my team measured:
items: 2 people x 4 days per month to produce invoices
~900 invoices typed one by one
Payment matching: 1 full day per month, ~3% mistakes
Developers interrupted every month for the usage export

script.intro: What I want at the end:
items: All invoices created and sent automatically on day 1
Payments matched automatically, reminders sent automatically

tickets.title: Our management report is two weeks late and nobody trusts the numbers
tickets.scope: Whole process: from '5th working day of the month' to 'Report presented'

script.text: Hi! One more thing on my list, and it's an important one for the board.

Every month we discuss figures that are already two weeks old. Our controller spends three days copy-pasting six Excel files into one master file, and every department calculates its KPIs differently – we even disagree on what an 'active customer' is. I want to see our key numbers at any moment, and I want one version of the truth.

script.intro: Here's what my team measured:
items: Report ready around day 13 of the month
3 days of copy-paste for the controller
6 departments, 6 different Excel formats
KPI definitions differ between teams

script.intro: What I want at the end:
items: Live KPI dashboard, updated at least daily
One shared definition per KPI
Controller spends time on analysis, not on copy-paste
